changes: OpenSSH security-key provider for ecdsa-sk keys in the Secure Enclave (aurora-sep-userspace sk/ at the aurora-sep-sk pin), with the udev rule that gives the sep-key group /dev/sep-key and the sysusers.d entry that creates the group.
notes: The provider is /usr/lib/<triplet>/libaurora-sep-sk.so (Debian's library directory) rather than alarm-aurora's /usr/lib/libaurora-sep-sk.so; use that path with ssh-keygen -w or SecurityKeyProvider. The upstream ssh-sk.md shows Fedora's /usr/lib64 path.
